directory_independent_readback.description: Provider change record: the signed history of document changes the daily watcher recorded for tracked model providers. Each diff leaf comes with its Merkle inclusion proof, assembled per request. States: each diff exactly as the watcher recorded it; the latest state per provider is free at the same path without history=1. Verification is free.

OSCAL evidence bundle for one obligation: EU AI Act Article 50/53, DORA or EU-CRA. Returns selected card objects with signature fields, any retained inclusion proofs, an OSCAL wrapper and assembly manifest. Does not verify input-card signatures. Reports manifest signing status and any unsigned reason. States: ASSEMBLED or ASSEMBLED-EMPTY; zero selected cards stays zero. Supported-card verification is free at /gspc-verify. No new measurement or conformity determination.

Inclusion proof bundle for leaves available in the last published Merkle root, read from that root. Each leaf comes with its hash, index and proof path, plus the root and the signed card count. States: included with a path, or absent from the root. Verification is free: recompute any path against /root.json.

/api/art50/marking-evidence

Art. 50 marking evidence: one signed pack for one generative output at a named URL, measured from its bytes. Detects C2PA and IPTC metadata only (C2PA manifest, assertion hashes, hard binding, claim signature; IPTC digitalSourceType); no watermark is read. States: DETECTED, NOT_DETECTED (not proof the output is unmarked) or UNCHECKABLE; never a legal determination. CSOAI is a C2PA member. Free unsigned preview; verification is free.
